class.name: Vehicle
class.brief_description: A physically simulated vehicle with suspension, steering, and drivetrain.
class.description:
Vehicle is a [RigidBody3D] node that simulates a multi-axle vehicle with suspension, steering, and a full drivetrain including engine, clutch, gearbox, and driveshaft. It uses [Axle] children to group wheels and distributes drive torque based on each axle's drive ratio.
The vehicle is configured via three [Resource] properties: [SuspensionData] for suspension tuning, [VehicleEngineData] for engine characteristics, and [GearboxData] for gear ratios and clutch behavior.
Input is provided through [member throttle_input], [member steer_input], and [member break_input] properties, which should be set each physics frame.

method.name: set_suspension_data
method.description: Sets the [SuspensionData] resource used to configure suspension parameters for all axles.

method.name: get_suspension_data
method.description: Returns the [SuspensionData] resource used for suspension configuration.

method.name: set_engine_data
method.description: Sets the [VehicleEngineData] resource used to configure the engine simulation.

method.name: get_engine_data
method.description: Returns the [VehicleEngineData] resource used for engine configuration.

method.name: set_gearbox_data
method.description: Sets the [GearboxData] resource used to configure the gearbox and clutch.

method.name: get_gearbox_data
method.description: Returns the [GearboxData] resource used for gearbox configuration.

method.name: set_throttle_input
method.description: Sets the throttle input. Values are clamped between 0.0 (no throttle) and 1.0 (full throttle).

method.name: get_throttle_input
method.description: Returns the current throttle input value (0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: set_steer_input
method.description: Sets the steering input. Values are clamped between -1.0 (full left) and 1.0 (full right).

method.name: get_steer_input
method.description: Returns the current steering input value (-1.0 to 1.0).

method.name: set_break_input
method.description: Sets the brake input. Values are clamped between 0.0 (no braking) and 1.0 (full braking).

method.name: get_break_input
method.description: Returns the current brake input value (0.0 to 1.0).

members.member: [GearboxData] resource configuring the vehicle's gearbox and clutch.
